verdict.rationale: Vue explicitly markets itself as 'incrementally adoptable' scaling from library to full framework (vue-docs-2), with a script-tag/CDN drop-in mode (vue-comm-6) and community confirmation that Vue can be 'selectively added' into existing pages/apps unlike other major frameworks (vue-comm-4), plus official tooling (Vue CLI, Vite) supporting scaling up to full SPA apps. Missing for 10: no independent case study documenting a full incremental migration path from script tag to full SPA in one project.
